description: This dataset contains sediment core measurements from a single geological event collected on April 8, 2022, at an elevation of 1,430 meters. The records include precise depth intervals ranging from 0 to 0.24 meters, alongside detailed isotopic analysis of Lead-210 (210Pb). Specifically, the data provides values for total, supported, and unsupported 210Pb concentrations, complete with their respective standard deviations. All samples originate from a specific location near latitude 21.28 and longitude -104.69. Researchers can utilize this sediment isotope data to reconstruct environmental histories, determine sedimentation rates, and analyze geochronological patterns within the studied region.
